No final-version formula mismatch is asserted.

The paper treats distribution and quasi-equivalence for cyclic and acyclic linear Gaussian directed graphs and gives analytical, graphical, and score-based structure-learning methods; it does not state a homoscedastic SCC Hall criterion.
The paper proves expected dimension for simple cyclic linear causal models and motivates score-based search, without a universal equal-error-variance SCC separator.
